input-field.name: freeShippingThreshold
input-field.label: Prag za brezplačno dostavo (€)
Free shipping threshold (EUR)
input-field.helpText: Znesek, nad katerim je dostava brezplačna. Prikaže se v zgornji vrstici in v košarici. Pustite prazno, da se sporočilo skrije.
Order value above which shipping is free. Shown in the top bar and in the cart. Leave empty to hide the message.

input-field.name: minOrderValue
input-field.label: Najnižja vrednost naročila (€)
Minimum order value (EUR)
input-field.helpText: Najmanjša vrednost izdelkov v košarici (z DDV, brez dostave), potrebna za oddajo naročila. Kupec vidi opozorilo v košarici in na blagajni. Pustite prazno ali 0, da je omejitev izklopljena.
Minimum value of the goods in the cart (gross, without shipping) needed to place an order. The customer sees a notice in the cart and at checkout. Leave empty or 0 to switch it off.

input-field.name: globalNotSellable
input-field.label: Ni na prodaj (vsi izdelki)
Not sellable (all products)
input-field.helpText: Enako kot "Ni na prodaj" na kategoriji, le za vse izdelke v trgovini, tudi tiste brez kategorije. Cene ostanejo vidne, namesto gumba za nakup je povpraševanje.
Same as "Not Sellable" on a category, but for every product in the shop, including products without a category. Prices stay visible; the buy button becomes an enquiry.

input-field.name: globalHidePrice
input-field.label: Skrij cene (vsi izdelki)
Hide prices (all products)
input-field.helpText: Enako kot "Skrij cene" na kategoriji, le za vse izdelke v trgovini, tudi tiste brez kategorije. Skrije ceno in gumb za nakup, mogoče je samo povpraševanje.
Same as "Hide Prices" on a category, but for every product in the shop, including products without a category. Hides the price and the buy button; only an enquiry is possible.

input-field.name: schemaBusinessName
input-field.label: Ime podjetja / trgovine
Business / store name
input-field.helpText: Uporabljeno v schema.org OnlineStore in Store (JSON-LD). Prazno = ime prodajnega kanala.
Used in the schema.org OnlineStore and Store markup (JSON-LD). Empty = sales channel name.

input-field.name: schemaStreet
input-field.label: Ulica in hišna številka
Street address
input-field.helpText: Prazno = oznaka fizične trgovine (Store) se ne izpiše.
Empty = the physical store (Store) markup is not printed.

input-field.name: schemaLatitude
input-field.label: Zemljepisna širina
Latitude
input-field.helpText: Optional, e.g. 46.2463

input-field.name: schemaLongitude
input-field.label: Zemljepisna dolžina
Longitude
input-field.helpText: Optional, e.g. 14.3556

input-field.name: schemaOpeningHours
input-field.label: Delovni čas (ena vrstica na pravilo)
Opening hours (one rule per line)
input-field.helpText: Oblika: "Mo-Th 08:00-17:00". Dnevi: Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa Su. Dni brez vrstice so zaprti.
Format: "Mo-Th 08:00-17:00". Days: Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa Su. Days without a line are closed.

input-field.name: schemaShippingRate
input-field.label: Cena standardne dostave (EUR, z DDV)
Standard delivery price (EUR, gross)
input-field.helpText: Za Google »shippingDetails«. Prazno = dostava se izpiše le pri izdelkih nad mejo za brezplačno dostavo.
For Google's "shippingDetails". Empty = shipping is only published on products above the free-delivery threshold.

input-field.name: schemaFreeShippingFrom
input-field.label: Brezplačna dostava od (EUR)
Free delivery from (EUR)
input-field.helpText: Prazno = brez brezplačne dostave.
Empty = no free delivery.

input-field.name: schemaReturnDays
input-field.label: Rok za vračilo (dni)
Return window (days)
input-field.helpText: Kupec plača poštnino za vračilo; vračilo po pošti ali v trgovini. Prazno = politika vračil se ne izpiše.
Customer pays return postage; return by mail or in store. Empty = no return policy is published.
